multiplicity: One confirmatory year ORB15 all-view, unchanged raw p. Eight other requested/clean sensitivity p-values in one globally Holm-adjusted family, fixed before scoring. References and combined statistics descriptive only, never promotion.

bootstrap.p_value: Two-sided centered bootstrap: (1 + count(abs(resampled_mean - observed_mean) >= abs(observed_mean))) / 2001
bootstrap.ci: Nominal percentile 95% interval of resampled daily mean; p and CI need not be exact inverses. Both pass conditions required.
bootstrap.daily_series: Chronological eligible dates, zero for no trade, no fictitious calendar-gap days; no historical discovery PnL in OOS inference
bootstrap.multiplicity: One confirmatory primary; no correction needed within that single family. No reference/subgroup may be promoted based on this run. Any optional inferential reference family must be declared before scoring and globally Holm-corrected, otherwise descriptive only. Existing retrospective 16-test Holm audit remains frozen.

methods.MFE_MAE: Lower/upper intrabar identification bounds, not exact tick sequence. Quantiles in points and initial-risk R. Time labels are first minute-bar extrema, may occur after modeled exit within that minute.
methods.stresses: Fixed fills, $24.50/$44.50/$64.50 roundtrip subtraction only; not new signals
methods.independence: Second fresh-process reproduction of same implementation, not an independently authored engine or statistical replication
methods.combined: Spent historical research plus new holdout; descriptive only, cannot rescue failed year

limitations: Explicit human release required for Step4
Limited local non-use evidence: independent never-use certification unavailable
Vendor publication vintages and usage rights not independently certified; no raw/public trade publication
